description: Department of Local Government North Central Province - Name and Detail of the New Chairman of Walikandu Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice announces the election results for a local government position (Chairman of Walikanda Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes and declarations, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7) rather than government personnel changes (which would require national-level government appointments).
